spans.s:
One.
2

Alone, solitary.
3 Other, different.
4 Chief, pre-eminent.
E.
इण to go, Uṇādi affix कन्

m. (-क्थी)
A coheir.
E.
एक one (father), ऋक्थिन् heir.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Alone, solitary.
E.
एक one, &c. कन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Making one.
2 One-handed.
3 Onerayed.
E.
एक and कर making, &c.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Performing the same office, answering the same end.
E.
एक and कार्य्य act.

m. (-लः)
One or the same time.
E.
एक and काल time.

n. (-नं)
Eating but one meal in any given time.
E.
एककाल and भोजन food.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Coeval, cotemporary.
E.
एक and कालीन relating to time.

m. (-लः)
1 A name of

BALARĀMA.
2

An epithet of KUVERA.
E.
एक and कुण्डल an ear-ring: wearing it in one ear.

n. (-रं)
The milk of one (nurse, &c.)
E.
एक and क्षीर milk.

m. (-रुः)
A spiritual brother, pupil of the same preceptor.
E.
एक and गुरु a religious preceptor; also with कन् added एकगुरुक.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Of the same town or village.
E.
एक one, ग्रामीण villager.

m. (-क्रः)
The name of a city: see हरिगृह.
E.
एक, चक्र a circle.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Solitary, alone.
2 Having one follower.
m. (-रः)
A rhinoceros.
E.
एक् alone, and चर who goes.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Going alone or with one follower only.
m. (-री)
A follower of BUDDHA.
E.
एक one, चर to go, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Thinking of one thing only, intent upon, absorbed in.
2 Of one mind, agreeing, concurring.
E.
एक one, चित्त the mind.

m. (-न्मा)
1 A king, a sovereign.
2 A Śūdra.
E.
एक best or one, जन्मन् birth.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Of one parentage, born of the same parents.
E.
एक and जात born.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 Of the same caste.
2 Once born.
m. (-तिः)
A Śūdra.
E.
एक one, and जाति birth or caste: not being regenerated by investiture, &c.

f. (-ज्या)
1 The chord of an arc.
2 Sine of 30° or of the radius.
E.
एक and ज्या a cord.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
One of many.
E.
एक and डतमच् affix of the superlative.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Either, one of two.
2 Other, different.
E.
एक and डतरच् affix of the comparative.

ind.
On one side, on one part.
E.
एक and तसिल् aff.

f. (-ता)
Unity, oneness.
E.
एक and तल् affix, or with त्व aff. एकत्व n. (-त्वं.)

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Closely attentive, having the mind fixed on one only object.
m. (-नः)
Musical unison: see the next.
E.
एक, तन to stretch or spread, घञ् aff.

m. (-लः)
Harmony, unison, the accurate adjustment of song, dance, and instrumental music.
(-ली)
An instrument for heating time, any instrument having but one note.
E.
एक one, uniform, and ताल musical measure or time.

m. (-र्थी)
A spiritual brother, an associate in religious offices or objects.
E.
एक one, the same, तीर्थ place of pilgrimage, इनि aff.

ind.
Together, in one, in one place.
E.
एक and त्रल् aff.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
एक and दंष्ट्र a tooth, single toothed or tusked; the fellow being broken off in a scuffle by KĀRTTIKEYA, or according to another legend by PARAŚURĀMA; also एकदन्त.

m. (-न्तः)
A name of GAṆEŚA: see the preceding.
E.
एक and दन्त a tooth.

ind.
At the same time, at once.
E.
एक and दाच् aff.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Sympathizing, having the same joy and sorrows.
E.
एक, and दुःख pain, सुख pleasure.

mfn. (-दृक्)
One-eyed.
m. (-दृक्)
1 A name of MAHĀDEVA
2 A crow.
E.
एक and दृश् an eye: ŚIVA is termed one-eyed from the eye in his forehead.

m. (-शः)
A part, a portion, a division.
E.
एक and देश place.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Elegantly formed.
2 Single bodied.
m. (-हः)
The planet MERCURY.
E.
एक best or one, and देह body.

ind.
In one way.
E.
एक and धाच् aff.

f. (-धूः)
A particular burthen or conveyance.
E.
एक an धुर् a load.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Cattle for special burthen, fit for but or kind of labour.
E.
see एकधुरीण.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
See the preceding.
E.
एक, धुर burthen, and वह who bears.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Cattle of special burthen.
E.
एक, धुर a burthen, ख affix which leaves ईण, or with अ affix forming एकधुर.

m. (-टः)
The principal actor in a drama, the manager.
E.
एक chief, and नट an actor.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Having one master.
m. (-थः)
Sole master or lord.
E.
एक and नाथ lord.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
An associate, a firm ally or partisan.
E.
एक one, पक्ष part; of the same side or party.

f. (-त्नी)
1 A faithful wife, one devoted to her husband.
2 The wife of a man who has no other wives.
E.
एक one or excellent, पति a husband, न substituted for the final, and ङीप् aff.

f. (-का)
A plant, white basil.
E.
एक and पत्र a leaf.

adv. n. (-दं)
Then, at that time, at once.
m. (-दः)
A single inflection of a verb or noun.
f. (-दी)
A road, a path or way.
E.
एक one, पद a foot, fem. affix ङीप्.

ind.
One over, a term at dice.
E.
एक and परि over, against.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sudden, rapid, coming suddenly or at once.
E.
एक and पात falling upon.

m. (-त्)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
एक best, and पाद् a ray.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
एक one, and पिङ्ग tawny: having a yellow mark in the place of one of his eyes.

m. (-लः)
See the preceding.
E.
as before.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Related, near of kin, united by the offering of the funeral cake.
E.
एक and पिण्ड a funeral cake.

f. (-ता)
Connexion by the funeral cake, consanguinity.
E.
एकपिण्ड and तल् affix; also with त्व, एकपिण्डत्वं.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having one or a principal result or object.
E.
एक and फल fruit.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Attached to a common master.
2 Worshipping one deity.
3 Eating together.
4 Eating but one meal, (a day.)
E.
एक and भक्त attached to, or भक्त food.

n. (-तं)
Eating but once a day as a religious obligation.
E.
एक, भक्त food, व्रत vow.

mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति)
1 Of one faith.
2 Believing in one deity.
E.
एक and भक्ति faith.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Of a simple or single nature or temperament.
E.
एक and भाव disposition.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Eating but one meal, (a day, &c.)
2 Eating together.
E.
एक and भुक्त eaten.

n. (-नं)
1 Eating in common, feeding together.
2 Eating one meal a day, &c.
E.
एक and भोजन food.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं)
1 Having one chief or head.
2 One faced.
E.
एक and मुख the mouth.

f. (-ला)
1 A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.)
2 Flax, (Linum.)
E.
एक and मूल root.

f. (-का)
A single string of flowers, pearls, &c.
E.
एक and यष्टिका a necklace, &c.

mfn. (-निः-निः-नि)
Uterine, of the same mother.
E.
एक and योनि womb.

m. (-जः)
A plant, (Verbesina scandens): see भृङ्गराज.
E.
एक excellent, and रजस् farina.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Of one flavour.
E.
एक and रस flavour.

n. (-त्रं)
One night, a night.
E.
एक and रात्रि night.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
For a night, of a night.
E.
एक and रात्रि night, with ठक् aff.

f. (-शिः)
A heap, a crowd.
E.
एक and राशि a heap.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Heaped or collected together.
E.
एकराशि and भूत become.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Alone, solitary; a various reading of एकक.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A name of

KUVERA.
2

A place or district in which for five Cos there is but one Phallus.
E.
एक one or best, लिङ्ग a mark, &c.

m. (-वः)
An aggregate of many, as in grammar, the formation of a compound noun of several nouns.
E.
एक, वत् like, भाव property.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Of one caste or tribe.
2 Of one colour.
3 Of one quality.
m. (-र्णः)
One unknown quantity, (in algebra.)
f. (-र्णी)
Beating time, marking musical measure by clapping the hands, or the instrument which does so, a castanet: see एकताली.
E.
एक, वर्ण a quality, a note, and ङीष् aff.

n. (-णं)
Uniliteral equation.
E.
एकवर्णं and समीकरण equation.

f. (-का)
A heifer one year old.
E.
एक, वर्ष a year, ठक् aff.

m. (-दः)
A musical instrument, a kind of drum or tabor.
E.
एक principal, वाद sound: high-sounding.

m. (-रः)
A chief warrior.
E.
एक and वीर a hero.

m. (-क्षः)
A desert place, in which but one tree is seen for four Cos.
E.
एक and वृक्ष a tree.

f. (-णी)
1 A single braid of hair.
2 A woman whose hair is tied in one braid.
E.
एक and वेणी a tress.

m. (-फः)
1 A horse.
2 Any animal whose hoof is not cloven.
E.
एक one, uniform, and शफ a hoof.

n. (-णं)
One only hope or refuge, especially applied to a deity.
E.
एक and शरण protection.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Consanguineous, of one body or blood.
2 Of one or the same body.
E.
एक, शरीर body.

m. (-यः)
Consanguineous descent.
E.
एकशरीर and अन्वय lineage.

m. (-म्भः)
Commencement of consanguinity by the union of father and mother.
E.
एकशरीर and आरम्भ beginning.

m. (-वः)
A descendant in a right line, a kinsman by blood.
E.
एकशरीर and अवयव a member.

n. (-त्वं)
Consanguineous descent or connexion.
E.
त्व added to the last.

m. (-खः)
A Brahman of the same branch or school.
E.
एक and शाखा a branch, (of the Vedas.)

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A title of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆ

A unicorn, a rhinoceros, &c.
E.
एक and शृङ्ग a mark or horn.

mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं)
Closely attentive, having the mind intent upon one object.
E.
एक one, and सृज to create, घञ् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
A small double drum, played by a string and ball attached to the body of it: see वृषाङ्कज.
E.
एक and सूत्र a thread.

m. (-नुः)
An only son.
E.
एक, and सूनु a son.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Collected, assembled, conjoined, in one site or place.
E.
एक and स्थ what stays.

n. (-नं)
One place, the same place.
E.
एक and स्थान place, aff.

f. (-नी)
A heifer one year old.
E.
एक, हायन a year, affix ङीष्.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Alone, solitary.
E.
एक and आकिनिच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
One-eyed.
m. (-क्षः)
A crow.
E.
एक and अक्षि an eye.

n. (-रं)
A monosyllable, especially the sacred monosyllable Om.
E.
एक and अक्षर a letter.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
1 Intent, closely attentive, fixed on one object.
2 Undisturbed, unperplexed.
3 Known, celebrated.
4 Single-pointed.
m. (-ग्रः)
The whole of a long line which is subdivided.
E.
एक and ग्र chief, &c.

f. (-ता)
Close and undisturbed attention.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, एकाग्रत्वं.

mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं)
Closely attentive: see the preceding.
E.
एक, अग्र्य chief, &c.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The planet MERCURY.
n. (-ङ्गं)
Sandal.
E.
एक best pre-eminent, and अङ्ग body.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Eleven, eleventh.
f. (-शी)
The eleventh day of the half month: it is especially sacred to VIṢṆU, and fasting on it is most efficacious.
E.
एकादशन् eleven, affix ड.

plur. mfn. (-श)
Eleven.
E.
एक one, दशन् ten, with आङ् inserted.

f. (-शा)
A name of PĀRVATĪ.
E.
अंश a part, with the neg. pref. and एक preeminent: chief and undivided.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Left, as a funeral feast, one who has recently partaken of it.
E.
एक one, (ancestor,) अनु after, दिष्ट shown.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1

Excessive.
2

Solitary, lonely, retired.
3 Aside, apart.
adv. n. (-न्तं)
1 Much, excessive.
2 Apart.
E.
एक one, and अन्त end.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Very compassionate, weakly charitable.
E.
एकान्त and करुण charitable.

ind.
1 Alone, apart, privately.
2 Much, exceedingly.
E.
एकान्त and तसिल् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Next but one.
E.
एक and अन्तर between.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Staying alone or apart.
E.
एकान्त and स्थित staying.

f. (-ब्दा)
A heifer one year old.
E.
एक and अब्द a year.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Closely attentive, intent.
E.
एक, अयन going.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
See the preceding.
E.
एकायन and गत being, having gone.

f. (-ली)
A single string of beads, flowers, &c.
E.
एक and आवली a row.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Having one sense or meaning.
2 Having one or the same object.
E.
एक and अर्थ meaning.

m. (-णः)
A simple attribute or predicate, as form, taste, smell, &c.
E.
एक one, आश्रित invested, गुण property.

f. (-ष्टी)
A pod or seed of cotton.

m. (-लः)
A plant: see वकपुष्प; the flowers are sacred to ŚIVA.
f. (-ली)
A medicinal plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
एक best, अष्टि seed, and ल what gives or takes, from ला with क aff.

n. (-हः)
The period of one day.
E.
एक and अहन् a day.

m. (-मः)
A day's journey.
E.
एकाह and गम going.
